title: The Iced Cake
scene: At 4:15 PM, the wedding cake had its sugar roses crushed. The bakery walk-in freezer jammed shut from 4:00 to 4:30.

suspects.name: Nora Pike
suspects.testimony: I was frosting the cake in the display case until 4:15. The freezer never held me.
suspects.contradiction: The display case was empty from 4:02, and flour marks on the freezer handle match Nora's gloves.

suspects.name: Basil Reed
suspects.testimony: I was piping borders at the front bench from 4:05 to 4:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The bench camera shows Basil piping nonstop from 4:04 to 4:26.

suspects.name: Imani Cole
suspects.testimony: I was loading boxes at the back dock from 4:00 to 4:20; the freezer door faced away.
suspects.alibiProof: The dock manifest has Imani's signature at 4:02 and 4:19.

suspects.name: Otto Vale
suspects.testimony: I was ringing up a customer at 4:15, right beside the display case.
suspects.alibiProof: Register three logged a sale at 4:14 under Otto's till code.
